anomalies.rule: Numbering Integrity — Detect Missing Invoice Number, Duplicates, and Field Conflicts
details: Field: InvoiceId | Current: SAP-BE-2026-01001 | Suggested: Unique business invoice number
InvoiceId must be unique. Multiple rows with the same InvoiceId indicate a duplicate. Ensure only one authoritative document exists or cancel/replace correctly.
